token=apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'))['access_token'];
playlist_ids=[128,129,131,130,127,132]

def playlist_total_minutes(pid):
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=token)
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    total_seconds=sum(s.get('duration',0) or 0 for s in songs)
    # assume duration is seconds per song; convert
    return {
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'title': pl.get('title'),
        'num_songs': len(songs),
        'total_seconds': total_seconds,
        'total_minutes_exact': total_seconds/60,
    }

results=[playlist_total_minutes(pid) for pid in playlist_ids]
for r in results:
    print(r['playlist_id'], r['title'], 'songs', r['num_songs'], 'total_seconds', r['total_seconds'], 'minutes_exact', r['total_minutes_exact'])

max_r=max(results, key=lambda x: x['total_seconds'])
print('max_playlist_id', max_r['playlist_id'])
print('max_minutes_exact', max_r['total_minutes_exact'])
print('rounded_minutes', int(round(max_r['total_minutes_exact'])))

arguments.code:
from math import isfinite

token=apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'))['access_token']

# fetch all playlists (paginated)
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

# compute total duration in minutes for each playlist
candidates=[]
for pl in all_playlists:
    songs=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=token).get('songs',[])
    total_seconds=sum((s.get('duration') or 0) for s in songs)
    total_minutes=total_seconds/60
    candidates.append({
        'playlist_id': pl['playlist_id'],
        'title': pl.get('title'),
        'total_minutes_exact': total_minutes,
        'total_seconds': total_seconds,
    })

max_c=max(candidates, key=lambda x: x['total_seconds'])
rounded_minutes=int(round(max_c['total_minutes_exact']))
print('max_playlist', {k:max_c[k] for k in ['playlist_id','title','total_minutes_exact','total_seconds']})
print('rounded_minutes', rounded_minutes)

# complete task with answer value only
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=rounded_minutes)
